title: ChatGPT Ads Hits $1B, and the Buying Model Has Changed
desc: ChatGPT Ads hit a $1B run rate in under 200 days. Self-service now lists 47 countries, and CPC bidding has replaced fixed CPM as the default way to buy.
keywords: chatgpt ads, chatgpt ads countries, chatgpt ads manager, openai advertising, ai search advertising, chatgpt ads cpc, ai search optimization
cta: Want to be the answer, not just the ad beside it?
faqs: How big is ChatGPT Ads now?

OpenAI said on August 31, 2026 that ChatGPT Ads reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate in less than 200 days after launch, and that the platform is used by tens of thousands of advertisers. A run rate is a projected annual pace based on current revenue, not revenue already booked over a full year.
Which countries can buy ChatGPT ads self-service?

OpenAI's help center table listed 47 countries with self-service marked Available on the day of the announcement, covering the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Japan, Korea, Brazil, Mexico and most of the EU and EEA, plus Algeria, Bahrain, Lebanon, Morocco, Qatar and Tunisia. The United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia were not on the self-service list. The table is updated continuously, so check it for your own country.
How do you pay for ChatGPT ads?

OpenAI reported that CPC and outcome-optimized bidding now account for the majority of campaigns, and that Pixel and Conversions API have become important foundations for measurement and optimization. Earlier campaigns ran on fixed impression pricing with a lifetime budget, so results from an early test are not directly comparable to a campaign bought today.
Do ChatGPT ads affect the answers ChatGPT gives?

OpenAI states that ads in ChatGPT are always clearly labeled and separate from ChatGPT's answers, that advertising does not influence the answers ChatGPT provides, and that advertisers do not receive access to people's private conversations. Because paid and organic remain separate, earning a citation inside the answer is still a distinct objective from buying an ad slot beside it.
body:
September 1, 2026. If you tested ChatGPT Ads earlier this year and shelved it, the thing you tested no longer exists in the same form. On August 31 OpenAI announced that ChatGPT Ads has reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate in less than 200 days, opened self-service buying across India, Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, and, in the same post, described a buying model that is not the one early testers used. The line to read twice is this one: CPC and outcome-optimized bidding now account for the majority of campaigns. Fixed-cost impressions were the on-ramp. They are no longer the default.

What OpenAI reported

  1. $1 billion annualized run rate in under 200 days, with tens of thousands of advertisers. A run rate is a projected pace, not money booked.
  2. Self-service expansion. Advertisers in India, Europe, the Middle East and North Africa can now buy through Ads Manager directly. Ads run in over 40 countries via the OpenAI Ads Solutions team and agency or technology partners.
  3. The buying model has matured. CPC and outcome-optimized bidding account for the majority of campaigns, and OpenAI names Pixel and Conversions API as foundations for measurement.
  4. Targeting has grown up, with product feeds, platform and geographic targeting and custom audiences.
  5. SMBs are a material share. Ads Manager launched in May and opened the platform to small and medium businesses, which OpenAI says are now a material portion of the business.
  6. Two outcome claims. An ecommerce advertiser reported 3x return on ad spend across campaigns over 28 days, and a technology partner reported that more than 80% of ad-driven ChatGPT traffic came from new customers.
  7. The guardrails are restated. Ads are labeled and separate from answers, advertising does not influence answers, and advertisers get no access to private conversations.

Count the country list yourself

The announcement says over 40 countries. OpenAI's help center maintains the actual table, and on the day of the announcement it listed 47 countries with self-service marked Available, covering the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Japan, Korea, Brazil, Mexico and most of the EU and EEA. The Middle East and North Africa entries are Algeria, Bahrain, Lebanon, Morocco, Qatar and Tunisia. Absent from that table are the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia, alongside Singapore, Turkey, Egypt, Nigeria and South Africa. From the Gulf, the route today is still the OpenAI Ads Solutions team or a partner, not a card and a login. The table changes continuously, so check your own billing country before you plan a launch date around it.

What it means for operators

Re-baseline any test you ran before May. A lifetime-budget campaign bought on impressions and a CPC campaign bought on outcomes are not the same experiment. If ChatGPT Ads underperformed in the spring, that result has expired.

Install measurement before you spend. OpenAI calls Pixel and Conversions API foundations for optimization, which is another way of saying outcome bidding cannot optimize toward something it cannot observe. Buying on outcomes without conversion signal wired up is buying impressions with extra steps.

Treat both outcome numbers as hypotheses. The 3x return and 80% new-customer figures are advertiser and partner reported inside a vendor announcement, not audited, with unnamed samples. The 80% claim is the one worth testing, because if AI-search traffic really skews that hard to first time buyers it is an acquisition channel, not a retargeting one, and it should be measured on first touch rather than last click.

Do not let paid crowd out earned. OpenAI states that advertising does not influence the answers ChatGPT provides, so the organic recommendation and the ad slot remain two separate contests. A $1 billion ad business raises the price of the paid one and does nothing to the earned one, so the case for being cited in the answer gets stronger as ad prices rise.

This is the channel we covered when ChatGPT Ads arrived inside HubSpot in July, and the direction since then is consistent: more markets, more targeting, more measurement. If you want the earned half handled properly, that is our AI search optimization work, and the pipeline it feeds is the same one our lead generation team runs.
